# PDF-LIB 1.17.1

`pdf-lib.esm.min.js` is the unmodified standalone ES module from the official
[`pdf-lib@1.17.1` npm package](https://registry.npmjs.org/pdf-lib/-/pdf-lib-1.17.1.tgz).
The module includes its runtime dependencies. The extension loads it locally,
without a CDN or remote code. Its MIT license is in `LICENSE.md`.

Upstream: https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib/tree/v1.17.1
